crossRefs.note: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to…
For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
crossRefs.keyword: even that which hath already been done. or, in those thingswhich have been already done

translations.web: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.
translations.bsb: Then I turned to consider wisdom and madness and folly; for what more can the king’s successor do than what has already been accomplished?
translations.kjv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
translations.asv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been done long ago.
